people.name: Ardon
people.line: Son of Caleb, brother of Jether and Mered

people.name: Azubah
people.line: Wife of Caleb and mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Son of Hezron, descendant of Judah

people.name: Hezron
people.line: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah, ancestor of David.

people.name: Jerioth
people.line: Wife of Caleb; mother of unnamed children.

people.name: Jesher
people.line: A son of Caleb and Azubah.

translations.web: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translations.bsb: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translations.kjv: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
translations.asv: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
